comment: Phase 3 — api-key credential-mediation route, JWKS-validation variant. Mirrors 00-mcp-apikey.json but validates the inbound token LOCALLY via jwks-token-validation.groovy instead of introspection, selected by the BFF's X-Token-Validation: jwks header (set when ff_mcp_gateway_jwks is on). Sorts BEFORE 00-mcp-apikey.json so it wins for /mcp/apikey when the header is present; when absent, 00-mcp-apikey.json (introspection) matches instead. After local validation, p1az-decision.groovy runs the PingOne Authorize decision (parity with 00-mcp-apikey.json and the Node gateway); it reads the token claims from attributes['oauth2AccessToken'] set by jwks-token-validation.groovy. On PERMIT the terminal apikey-dispatch handler pulls the vault service key via the BFF bridge and calls demo_data_service with X-API-Key.
name: mcp-apikey-dispatch-jwks
condition: ${find(request.uri.path, '^/mcp/apikey') and not empty request.headers['X-Token-Validation'] and request.headers['X-Token-Validation'][0] == 'jwks'}
